{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cake|Cake]]

A '''Lane cake''' is a layered white cake traditional in the [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|American South]]. The outside has a white frosting, and each layer has different ingredients. For example, one layer may have pecans and coconut, the next layer almonds. Due to the complicated preparations and multiple ingredients, Lane cakes are considered difficult to make.

==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (225 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], at room temperature
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (480 g) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3½ cups (525 g) all-purpose [[Cookbook:flour|flour]]
* 3½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 cup (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]

===Filling===

* 8 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 1 cup (240 g) white granulated sugar
* ½ lb (225 g) butter, at room temperature
* 1 cup (240 g) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]], seeded and coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 cup (240 g) [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]], chopped
* ½ cup (120 g) shredded dried [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Bourbon|bourbon]] or [[Cookbook:Grape Juice|grape juice]]
* 1 cup candied [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherries]]

== Procedure ==

=== Cake ===

# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
# [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
# Mix the milk and flour mixture into the butter, beginning with the flour and alternating between the two until fully incorporated. Do not overmix, or the cake will be tough.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites to medium-stiff peaks in a clean, grease-free bowl. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the beaten whites into the batter.
# Transfer the batter between greased and [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pans]]. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F until the tops are springy and a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted int the middle comes out clean.
# Cool and unmold the cakes.

=== Filling ===

# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the yolks and sugar together in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Stir in the butter.
# Cook the yolk mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon. Do not overcook, or it will curdle. Remove from the heat.
# Stir in the raisins, pecans, coconut, bourbon, and candied cherries.
# Let cool slightly, then spread the filling over the cake layers.
